How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Directorate of Enforcement Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.enforcementdirectorate.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Directorate of Enforcement Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Directorate of Enforcement Recruitment 2026 is 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the posts of Additional Director and Joint Director of Enforcement?
faq.answer: There are a total of 38 vacancies announced for the posts of Additional Director of Enforcement (18 posts) and Joint Director of Enforcement (20 posts) in the Directorate of Enforcement Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Directorate of Enforcement Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the post of Additional Director of Enforcement is Level-13, and for the Joint Director of Enforcement, it is Level-12, as per the 7th Central Pay Commission guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Directorate of Enforcement, which is https://www.enforcementdirectorate.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation, meaning eligible government officials can apply for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned for the Directorate of Enforcement Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates should check the official notification for any updates regarding fees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of the Directorate of Enforcement?
faq.answer: The official website of the Directorate of Enforcement is https://www.enforcementdirectorate.gov.in/. This is where you can find the official notification and application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110001.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key details to check before applying?
faq.answer: Before applying, candidates must carefully check the eligibility criteria, age limit, required qualifications, and ensure all details in the application form are correct. Attaching self-attested copies of necessary documents is also crucial.
